mapper.select: SELECT assignment_id AS assignmentId, user_account_id AS userAccountId, role_id AS roleId, (revoked_at IS NULL) AS active, assigned_at AS assignedAt, revoked_at AS revokedAt FROM role_assignment WHERE user_account_id = #{userAccountId} ORDER BY assigned_at DESC

SELECT ra.assignment_id AS assignmentId, ra.user_account_id AS userAccountId, e.name AS employeeName, e.work_email AS employeeWorkEmail, ra.assigned_at AS assignedAt FROM role_assignment ra INNER JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = ra.user_account_id WHERE ra.role_id = #{roleId} AND ra.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY e.name ASC
